text: July PPI is unchanged monthly and rises 4.7% annually. Core PPI rises 0.2% monthly and 4.2% annually. Goods prices fall 0.7%, including a 3.1% energy decline, while services rise 0.2%. Initial jobless claims stand at 209,000.

meta.note: Monthly and annual price measures remain directionally distinct across different temporal layers.

text: Chief Revenue Officer Denise Dresser is leaving OpenAI less than a year after joining. Dali Rajic will replace her as CRO, with Dresser remaining briefly to support the transition. Her departure follows Brad Lightcap's announced exit two days earlier.

meta.note: The entry isolates the revenue leadership transfer; other recent executive departures remain separate events.

text: Workday shares rise nearly 18% and its market value closes near $51B following a report that Silver Lake is in acquisition talks with the company. Discussions are reported as ongoing over recent months. Neither Workday nor Silver Lake has confirmed the talks.

meta.note: The acquisition remains unconfirmed, limiting the event to the reported negotiation state and observed market repricing.

text: Reddit will enter the S&P 500 on Aug. 18, replacing AvalonBay Communities. Shares rise 11% in extended trading after the announcement. Reddit becomes the second pure-play social media company represented in the index alongside Meta.

meta.note: Index inclusion is announced but becomes operational on Aug. 18.
